data.notes: Confirmed March 2027 listings are still sparse this far out; Rio’s club and festival calendar will likely fill in later, so this cut prioritizes ticketed concerts already published by venues or major ticketing platforms.

events.title: Vice-Versa: Arnaldo Antunes e Adriana Calcanhotto
events.summary: Arnaldo Antunes and Adriana Calcanhotto bring their joint Vice-Versa project to Qualistage, supporting their first album created together. The venue page confirms the Rio show for 20 March 2027 at 21:30.

events.title: Lifehouse: Best of Acoustic
events.summary: Lifehouse plays Rio on its Brazil run with an acoustic-format show led by Jason Wade. Songkick lists the confirmed Rio date as 16 March 2027 at Teatro Clara Nunes, with doors at 19:00.

events.title: Supercombo no Circo Voador
events.summary: Brazilian alt-pop/rock band Supercombo brings its “Rogério 10 Anos” tour to Circo Voador, marking a decade of the album Rogério. The Eventim listing confirms the Rio date, venue, and 20:00 start time.

events.title: Amado Batista at Espaço Hall
events.summary: Veteran Brazilian popular/romantic singer Amado Batista is listed by Espaço Hall for a 6 March 2027 show in Barra da Tijuca. The event page notes an evening opening and a planned 22:30 show time.

events.title: Bosque Folia - Sextas de Carnaval 2027
events.summary: Carnaval-themed Friday club night at Bosque Bar with funk carioca DJs Marcelin O Brabo, SWAG and Matica plus open-format sets from Bruna Areas and Pedro do Rio; a local scene event rather than an arena-scale carnaval package.
